transportPage.title: Transport
transportPage.subtitle: Bajaj, taxi, and getting around
transportPage.howDoISub: Quick answers for airport, lake boats, Blue Nile Falls, and town hops.
transportPage.aAirport: Bajaj or taxi from Bahir Dar Airport (BJR). Agree the price before you leave. Hotels can arrange a pickup if you message ahead.
transportPage.aBoat: Go to the main boat pier near the lakeshore. Shared tourist boats leave in the morning; private boats cost more. Confirm islands, time, and return before paying.
transportPage.pBoat: Shared boat from ~800–2,000 ETB · Private higher
transportPage.aFalls: Day trip by bajaj, shared minibus, or private car (about 30–40 minutes). Confirm return time. After rain the path can be muddy.
transportPage.pFalls: Round trip transport ~400–2,000 ETB depending on shared vs private
transportPage.aTown: Bajaj (tuk-tuk) is the default for short trips. Always agree the fare before starting. Walking works well near the pier and central hotels.
transportPage.pTown: Bajaj ~50–200 ETB / short trip · Taxi higher
transportPage.aBus: Long-distance coaches leave from the main bus station. Buy tickets early on busy days. Keep valuables with you.
transportPage.pBus: Depends on destination — confirm at the station
